standards.text: The learners demonstrate their expanding vocabulary knowledge as used in formal and informal situations; growing knowledge of grammatical structures; literal, inferential, and critical comprehension of literary and informational texts; and developing skills in composing and creating text in order to produce culture-appropriate texts based on their purpose, context, and target audience.

The learners apply literal, inferential, and critical comprehension of literary and informational texts and produce culture-appropriate texts: narrative and expository texts (explanation, news report) based on their purpose, context (national holidays), and target audience using simple, compound, and complex sentences, and age-appropriate and gender-sensitive language.
